newsitem.title: USA: United Petroleum sells natgas from Pa wells.
newsitem.headline: United Petroleum sells natgas from Pa wells.

text.p: United Petroleum Corp said Tuesday natural gas sales in Crawford County, Pa., started this week from the Gall No. 1 and Curtis No. 1 wells.

These are the initial two wells drilled in a 300-well drilling program announced last month and the first of the company's 40-well initial phase in a joint venture with Kastle Resources of Edinboro, Pa.

A third well (Williams No. 1) has recently been completed and is being connected to a gathering system this week. Sales from this well are expected to begin later this month. Drilling began on the fourth well (Szymanowski No. 1) last week, United Petroleum said.

The second part of the drilling program will begin this week in the Ohio Rose Run formation in Pickaway County, Ohio, where United Petroleum and Kastle have just confirmed their proposed well sites with 3-D seismic.
